name: base
purpose: regular 20 ns clock; vin steps between samples, slow ramps and a negative excursion; a three-sample reset while vin steps; a short rst pulse that covers no sample
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 135.5n 0 136.5n 0.8 300n 0.8 380n 0.3 461.5n 0.3 462.5n 0.9 600n 0.9 601n -0.5 700n -0.5 760n 0.5 820n -0.2 857.5n -0.2 858.5n 0.7 950n 0.7 951n 0 1000n 0 1100n 1 1200n 1]
Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=20n width=9.9n delay=9.95n rise=100p fall=100p
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 451.95n 0 452.05n 0.9 512.95n 0.9 513.05n 0 852.95n 0 853.05n 0.9 866.95n 0.9 867.05n 0 1200n 0]

XDUT (vin clk rst out) ct_lowpass_sampler

tran tran stop=1200n maxstep=50p strobeperiod=50p
save vin clk rst out

name: dc-start
purpose: vin starts at 0.6 V so the filter starts in equilibrium; irregular clock; a four-sample reset during a ramp, a one-sample reset pulse, and reset held to the end

name: tau-override
purpose: tau = 250 ns; regular 25 ns clock; a six-sample reset across a full-scale input step; slow ramp
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 50.5n 0 51.5n 1 350.5n 1 351.5n -0.8 700n -0.8 1000n 0.6 1199.5n 0.6 1200.5n -0.2 1500n -0.2]
Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=25n width=9.9n delay=12.45n rise=100p fall=100p
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 297.95n 0 298.05n 0.9 455.95n 0.9 456.05n 0 1500n 0]

XDUT (vin clk rst out) ct_lowpass_sampler tau=250n

tran tran stop=1500n maxstep=50p strobeperiod=50p
save vin clk rst out

name: vth-tr-override
purpose: vth 0.8 V and tr 100 ps with 180 ps clock edges: a 0.45 V threshold samples 70 ps early and a 200 ps output transition is still moving when scoring starts; vin starts at 0.5 V; a two-sample reset and a short rst pulse between samples; 25 ps grid
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.5 60.5n 0.5 61n -0.7 140n -0.7 220n 0.9 300.5n 0.9 301n -0.4 420n -0.4 421n 0.8 600n 0.8]
Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=20n width=9.9n delay=9.8625n rise=180p fall=180p
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 339.95n 0 340.05n 0.9 379.95n 0.9 380.05n 0 451.95n 0 452.05n 0.9 455.95n 0.9 456.05n 0 600n 0]

XDUT (vin clk rst out) ct_lowpass_sampler vth=0.8 tr=100p

tran tran stop=600n maxstep=25p strobeperiod=25p
save vin clk rst out
